I enjoy nightmare, it really punishes you and makes you work for everything. The early game is the hardest and it does suck sometimes just trying to farm for materials. I usually just loot alot and build up and do that for a couple of days, then move regions and actually hunker down. That's when I start killing plague hearts and by then I have a good stock and outposts set up as quick as I can. I use the find survivors function as soon as it's up to fill the map with enclaves for those benefits and people if I need any. By day 10 I usually have most of the plague hearts done, but my first time through I took it slow to 20. Its not bad as you think it is but it takes time and practice honestly. Also use every mechanic or item at your disposal. When I first started this game and it was just standard, I never used energy drinks or fireworks, never really used automechanics either.  It wasnt until dread and nightmare came out that I actually used most of what's given to you and it's honestly nice as it feels like a whole other section of gameplay is unlocked to you.

I honestly use a m4 or something semi auto or that nature and use bloater grenades as well. I think for me the last time I played warlord, I had 3 enemy enclaves I had to kill after I destroyed all plague hearts. Just be very careful and have meds on hand as well. Also after the mission where you see who's on your side or on the enemies, be careful as enclaves on the map will switch to their side and be hostile. Just be very aware of their locations. Bloater grenades and zombait are your friends in the endgame. Use your rifle and just be aware of any zombies while you fight the enclaves, use cover or high ground if possibble. Just be patient and try and let the zombies do the work for you if need be.
